c: Power of Lire will periodically trigger a Gold Fever and pulse several times based on
. With each pulse, most enemies and pickups, including
Experience, on the screen will instantly be deleted and turned into bags of money of different colors, which are then magnetized toward the player. The bags of money are a different sprite from the
Coin Bag or the
Rich Coin Bag, yet they do not appear in the Collection. Then, the Gold Fever continues as normal. While this cannot instantly kill certain enemies, such as the Atlanteans guarding the
stage items, it will still deal a large amount of damage to them with each pulse, equaling one tenth of the Gold the player has accumulated during that run.
Compared to
, Power of Lire has decreased
and a slower Interval, and loses the ability to spawn Little Hearts.
Unlike most weapons, Power of Lire cannot be upgraded further with Limit Break.
See Combos for a list of all item interactions.
